scope: One-dimensional component adaptation of Miao et al. (2025), not native localization/AEKF/recovery reproduction
fit_assumption: First five seconds of each development scene are clean; not an authenticated bootstrap guarantee
features: Causal first differences of candidate-minus-reported-localization and candidate-minus-assumed-anchor speed residuals; reset across missing input or a gap greater than 100000 us
normalization: Prefix mean and sample standard deviation only; no variance floor. Fewer than two finite differences or zero/unrepresentable scale invalidates calibration. At most the first 1000 chronological valid prefix differences are retained.
bandit: 36 arms in eps-major/MinPts-minor order; one pull per arm, then 36 UCB1 pulls; reward rounded to 12 decimals; round UCB scores to 12 decimals, ties take lowest arm index. Choose the next UCB arm after 72 pulls. Frozen after prefix; no post-prefix arm or normal-set updates.
reward: Eq21 adaptation: one non-noise cluster -> MinPts/eps; multiple clusters -> maximum cluster mean silhouette excluding noise, singleton silhouette zero; no clusters -> -1. Every pull uses the same clean-prefix sample.
dbscan: Exact one-dimensional Euclidean epsilon neighborhoods, inclusive, self included. Connected core points form clusters; ambiguous borders attach to the first cluster in ascending coordinate order. New queries are normal iff within inclusive eps of a frozen prefix core point; queries do not create cores or change clusters.
wrappers: Match prior statistical-monitor wrappers: unprotected warmup uses legacy agreement, then fresh candidate only on a monitored non-alarm; protected uses candidate on a monitored non-alarm, otherwise only an eligible assumed anchor. Missing/invalid evidence remains abstention. No extra 500mm/s bound is applied to these comparison controls.
numerics: Reject nonfinite model arithmetic; no Infinity/NaN JSON. A post-prefix nonfinite standardized difference disables its track until scene end; protected fallback still requires eligibility.
evaluation: Same fourteen fixed decision-level scenarios and five phases as prior comparison; localization remains an outcome proxy. All-request/phase coverage, errors, accepted disagreements above2m/s, alarms, calibration status, first alarm latency and censoring retained. Alarm delay is event time, never decision-call execution time.
